name: Bengal Tiger
description: The Bengal Tiger is the national animal of India. They are apex predators and essential to maintaining the ecological balance of the forest.
funFact: No two tigers have the same stripes!

name: Indian Elephant
description: These gentle giants are highly intelligent and social creatures. They play a crucial role in shaping the forest ecosystem by dispersing seeds.
funFact: Elephants can recognize themselves in a mirror!

name: Black Panther
description: A melanistic variant of the leopard. Their dark coat helps them blend into the dense, dark forests of the Western Ghats.
funFact: If you look closely, you can still see their spots hidden in their dark fur!

name: Great Indian Hornbill
description: Known for their large size and colorful beak. They are 'farmers of the forest' because they drop seeds over large areas.
funFact: Their beak looks heavy, but it is actually hollow and very light!

name: Indian Roller
description: The state bird of Karnataka. It gets its name from its spectacular aerobatic displays during the breeding season.
funFact: It flashes brilliant blue wings when it takes flight!

name: Sandalwood Tree
description: Famous for its fragrant wood and oil. Karnataka is globally renowned for producing high-quality sandalwood.
funFact: Sandalwood trees get some of their nutrients by attaching their roots to nearby trees!
